note: Sample entries for the mockup, written from real ABX releases. The live feed is generated by the news job.

entries.title: ABX CLI 0.8.0: creator wallets can pay their own gas
entries.body: A creator wallet with enough native funds now pays transaction value and fees itself. When it cannot, zero-value calls fall back to ABX gas sponsorship where the account is eligible. The new --embedded flag replaces --sponsor, which stays as an alias, and the CLI now checks every payload the service returns against the local transaction before signing.

entries.title: BAMFS is now ABX FS, at fs.abx.io
entries.body: The onchain file system formerly at bamfs.app now runs as ABX FS. It chunks and deduplicates a folder, stores it onchain and serves it from a content-addressed gateway. The site labels it prerelease and unaudited software.

entries.title: Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum move to supported
entries.body: CLI 0.7.4 and SDK 0.7.1 mark Ethereum mainnet, Base, Arbitrum and Arbitrum Sepolia as supported networks. Robinhood Chain remains in beta. Gas sponsorship is offered on Base and Arbitrum only.

entries.title: Sponsored gas reaches Arbitrum
entries.body: CLI 0.7.3 allows the sponsored signing lane on Arbitrum and Arbitrum Sepolia when both the live service and the account advertise eligibility. Recognizing a chain does not by itself grant sponsorship.

entries.title: CLI 0.7.1 tidies output and OpenSea links
entries.body: Piped output drops color codes, the sponsored creator-wallet lane appears in missing-key recovery help, deploy-time collection identity is kept in contractURI, and Ethereum and Base OpenSea refresh links return.

entries.title: abx-core-v3 factories go live
entries.body: The current generation of ABX factories deploys at the same address on every chain through a keyless CREATE2 proxy. The v2 generation stops taking new deployments; its collections stay readable and writable.
